note: Names, descriptions and grades match the kit starter's official list. Every guide below is written fresh for this codex. Sources are pages read on 21 November 2026; a guide never cites a page that was not read.
title: The Leonida Trophy Codex

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn, and it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut: it needs the full story, the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, the eight stranger strands, every side strand and all the miscellaneous trophies. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC, and one playthrough is enough, so treat this as a project plan rather than a single task. PowerPyx puts the whole journey at about 200 hours (60 to 80 for the story, about 100 for the 100% checklist, about 10 for cleanup), while Push Square warns it can run past 250 hours, so budget 200 and be pleasantly surprised. Keep cheats off your platinum save the entire time, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter, and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the first morning it appears.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission of Chapter 1, and the first trophy most players will earn. Gone Fishing is story, so it cannot be missed: just play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops when it closes. There is nothing to prepare and no choice inside the mission that affects it. Use the quiet opening to build good habits for the long road ahead: turn on progress and collectible notifications in the settings, and start scanning every new vehicle you see with the WAiNK phone app, because the 100% checklist later wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned and the early ones are the easiest to forget. Meet Cal during this stretch of the game too, since his fishing quests lead to Baited My Tackle. One playthrough, no difficulty setting, no replay needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and this bronze follows automatically. PowerPyx notes it pops a little late, once you have cleared the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so do not panic if the chapter ends and the trophy has not appeared yet. The one thing Chapter 1 demands of a platinum hunter is the balcony meditation: the morning after the Down to Earth mission, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house, walks out to the balcony, and you must follow her and accept. PowerPyx flags it as the game's only potentially missable trophy moment, because the balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1 and it is still unconfirmed whether the Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs it. Do it, make a manual save at the end of the chapter, and move on.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 and this pops automatically, again a little late: PowerPyx says it arrives after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up, because the Coffee Break mission unlocks playing as both Jason and Lucia together, and that is the moment most of the partner trophies and the character-specific questlines become possible. Before you leave Chapter 2, start the strands that only unlock here: Billy's jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, Bret's hunting quests, and Moses, who gives you the Scooter Bros app. Kenton, who went quiet after Chapter 1, texts Jason again around now, so his treasure diving can continue. Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary; with no mission replay, chapter saves are your only safety net.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy follows, popping after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, according to PowerPyx. Chapter 3 is the busiest chapter for trophy setup: Andy's Lucia-only questline starts with a phone call, Randy's Wish List opens after the Key Cloner mission, Tyrone's lab strand begins after Here, Kitty Kitty, and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hand you the Snap Gun that Sneakthief needs. The Cartel Heist mission in this chapter carries its own trophy, Break the Bank. Do the optional missions as they appear rather than hoarding them, because many disappear after a while, even though the 100% checklist only needs 100 of several hundred. Scan vehicles and study animals with the binoculars whenever you meet something new.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this bronze is yours, awarded after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 is heavy with story trophies: Child's Play, Headliners and the VCIA Takedown all sit here, and the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... introduces the large bank vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal needs. Note the open dispute in this codex: PowerPyx's table also ties the final-mission gold trophy to Starting From Zero, while GTABase, Insider Gaming and eGamers place the final mission and Snow Storm in a fifth chapter. Our call follows the majority: there are five chapters and the story continues past Chapter 4. Either way nothing is missable here, so just finish the chapter, bank a manual save, and keep going.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story and this gold unlocks, opening free roam for the long cleanup that follows. GTABase, Insider Gaming and eGamers all describe the ending as a fifth chapter, with Operation Savage Glory (Snow Storm) as its mission, while PowerPyx's trophy table ties the final mission to the end of Chapter 4; the Disputes tab records both versions and our call. Whichever chapter count you trust, the practical facts agree: there is no mission replay, free roam continues after the credits, and the 100% Completion checklist only becomes visible under Progress, then Stats, after the story, even though everything you did during the story already counts toward it. Do not turn cheats on to celebrate: cheats disable trophies and saving, and most of the mop-up is still ahead of you.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and this bronze pops as part of the story. There is no preparation, no alternate route and no way to miss it: play the mission to its end. Breakfast Run sits early in Chapter 2, so it will usually be one of the first story trophies after the chapter trophies. The mission is a good moment to remember that story trophies arrive slightly delayed in this game: chapter trophies pop after the first mission or two of the next chapter, so a missing pop right at a chapter boundary is normal, not a glitch. Keep playing and it will land. If you are tracking progress in the app, mark it earned and let the story tab fill itself in as you go.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission, and this bronze is automatic. It is pure story progression: no side requirement, no collectible, no difficulty condition. The heist is one of the set-piece missions of the middle chapters, so expect a longer mission with several phases rather than a quick errand. Once it is done, the game keeps moving into the late-chapter content where the robbery trophies begin to open up: bank vaults, Payday Loans and the fences that turn marked bills into clean money. There is nothing to do differently here to protect the platinum, but it is worth making a manual save after any big story mission, since the game offers 15 manual slots and no mission replay.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play and this bronze unlocks with the story. Like every mission trophy in this list, it cannot be missed and needs no preparation: finish the mission and move on. Child's Play is one of three story-mission trophies clustered in Chapter 4, alongside Headliners and the VCIA Takedown, so Chapter 4 pays out several bronzes in quick succession as you work through it. If you are playing with the spoiler shield on in this codex, this trophy stays hidden until you reveal it or earn it, because its mission name is a story beat. That is the point of the shield: chapter and mission names are exactly what the hidden list protects.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners and this bronze pops automatically. It is a story trophy in the full sense: unmissable, with no side objective and no choice that changes it. Headliners sits in the same chapter as Child's Play and the VCIA Takedown, so expect Chapter 4 to hand you three mission bronzes plus the chapter trophy in one stretch. The name is stylised in the official list and in every guide that prints it, so search for DWNFALL exactly if you are cross-checking it against another list. As with all story trophies, the only advice that matters is the general one: keep manual saves at chapter boundaries, keep cheats off, and let the story carry you through.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown and this bronze unlocks with the story. It is the third of the Chapter 4 mission trophies, after Child's Play and Headliners, and like them it cannot be missed. The mission name gives away a story location, the Vice City International Airport, which is also where the hidden trophy Catch Me If You Can takes place, so the airport is worth learning well: you will come back to steal a docked passenger jet from gates E3 and E4. For now, just play the mission through. The airport takedown is a combat-heavy set piece, so stock up on body armour and ammunition beforehand if you are struggling, but nothing in the mission gates the trophy behind a performance target.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory and this bronze pops. GTABase, Insider Gaming and eGamers all place this mission in Chapter 5, which is the basis for our call in the Disputes tab that the story has five chapters, against PowerPyx's table tying the final mission to the end of Chapter 4. Either way, Snow Storm is a late-story mission trophy and cannot be missed. It is the last of the six named-mission story trophies: one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4 and one in Chapter 5, as Sixshore counts them. After this mission the story is nearly done, so make sure your chapter-boundary manual save is in place before the finale, because there is no mission replay to fall back on.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion checklist under Progress, then Stats, after the story, and work it to 100%. PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient, closer to 60% true completion, while Push Square warns you still need almost everything, and both are right in different ways: most categories ask for only a share, but a few demand everything. You need all robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting range golds, all 42 drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, but only 100 of the optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 of 397 stunts. Nothing on the list is missable and progress made during the story already counts, so start scanning and studying from Chapter 1. This is the hardest trophy and the bulk of the 200 hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game, in any mix of the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. PowerPyx and GTABase agree that flying under bridges is the quickest kind to rack up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed: performing the stunt once counts as completed. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and show stunt spots on the map under Exploration to compare against what you have done. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping: the extra 50 are the same work, and stopping early only creates a second cleanup pass. Stunt jumps have extra challenges attached, but those are not required for this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball by sinking a basket, playing a video game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. The trophy tracker counts nine types, and you can view them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, where scrolling over each one shows how many you have done. PowerPyx says you will do one of each automatically while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so do not chase this early: it is a trophy that resolves itself. The map filter for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them, which helps if one type is left at the end. If you are stuck on one, golf and pool are the easiest deliberate picks, since both are single-visit activities with no win condition attached.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds in total. PowerPyx counts 12 ranges across Leonida, while Push Square names two locations, Rodgers Ranch and Griffin Shooting Range, and the Disputes tab records the mismatch; our call is that there are 12 ranges and Push Square simply names two of them. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some are locked until you meet other conditions, which the map shows. Track progress under Touchpad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so there is a double payoff in doing them early. Gold medals here are also required in full by the 100% checklist, unlike most categories, so there is no way around the hard ones: practise the weapon types you are weakest with first.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so the efficient play is to finish each location properly while you are there instead of winning once and coming back. Find locations on the map under Touchpad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones, and note that some races charge an entry fee, so keep some cash in hand. Drone races are also time trials for the checklist: KeenGamer lists 42 drone time trials as a separate 100% line, so winning the race and clearing its time trial are two different jobs at the same spot. Do both in one visit and you will never need to return.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 available. Winning the same race again does not count, so variety is the whole requirement. GTABase and PowerPyx both count 40 unique race locations, and the 100% checklist raises the bar to 30 wins, so again the smart move is to keep winning new races past 20 rather than stopping. Track them under Touchpad, then Activities, then Racing, and pay attention to your car's rating if you bring your own vehicle: it can be improved with upgrades from Mod Shops, and many race locations let you hire a car instead. Races also count toward Master of None, so your first race win does double duty. There is no difficulty condition beyond winning, and races stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in his challenge. Push Square adds a concrete detail: fairly early on Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2kg, fishing in the marked area until you land one big enough, and you will need a boat with a fishing rod, though plenty can be hijacked nearby. Fishing also counts toward Master of None and raises Focus, so it is worth doing properly rather than rushing. If the challenge fish is not biting, check that you are fishing in the marked spot and not just anywhere on the water: the questline only advances at Cal's marked location.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, and you can do this from Chapter 1, though the TV is temporarily unavailable during some story sections. The fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is found on arcade cabinets around Leonida. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it, just reach the end. Pick whichever game you like best, since the trophy does not care which one. Note the separate 100% line: the checklist wants you to play all four video games, so this trophy is one quarter of that job.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete all five of Andy's quests, Lucia-only, and the trophy pops on the last one, Puff Puff Pass. The strand starts in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville, and the quests run in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (in three parts), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of it stays available after the story, so there is no rush, but it is Lucia-only, so do not expect to progress it while playing as Jason. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which only counts certain stranger questlines, so do not confuse the two.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear Kenton's treasure diving strand, seven shipwrecks in total, and the trophy unlocks on the final mission, which Push Square names as Maritime Disputes. Kenton hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from shipwrecks: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dive at them and use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, then bring it back. After the first set he calls you back to his shop, then marks more locations. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so the strand looks missable and is not: every trophy quest giver returns and stays available after the story. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. The 100% checklist wants 5 of his 7 treasure sets, so this strand overlaps the checklist too.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete all five of Billy's jobs and the trophy pops on the last one, Hometown Heroes. The strand starts at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and the jobs run: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. Everything stays available after the story, so you can do it at your own pace, but start it when it appears so you are not left with a whole strand at the end. Like Andy's and Tyrone's strands, Billy's does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy, which only credits certain stranger questlines. Billy's jobs are driving and job-based rather than combat-heavy, so they make a pleasant change from the robbery grind.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands. This is the fiddliest trophy in the list because not every side questline counts. PowerPyx and GTABase agree on four confirmed strands: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street racing mentor strand) and Pilot Pete (the delivery flights). They also agree on who does not count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the guide writers, so check the trophy's own progress counter in your trophy list before assuming a strand counted. None of these strands are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story in free roam, so do the four confirmed ones first and let the rest be confirmed by the community. See the Disputes tab for the full disagreement.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List and the trophy unlocks. The strand opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal a Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. After that he gives you a list of 16 sports cars to deliver to his garage in west Vice City, marked with a green RK icon. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list, and check the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting grounds, and cars in better condition pay more. It can all be done after the story, so treat it as a relaxed cleanup job between the bigger checklists.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand and the trophy pops on his last job, Spin On This (shut down the labs). It is Jason-only, and it starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for synthetic labs around Vice City, and you destroy them as part of the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives you the final job. Everything stays available after the story, so there is no deadline, but it is Jason-only, so switch characters before you start. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Lab destruction is straightforward combat and demolition work; bring explosives and a fast car, clear the labs in batches, and the strand resolves itself.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation as well, because it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. There are 18 marked spots across 10 locations, and meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia together counts twice, which is how the counter climbs. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The trap is in Chapter 1: the morning after Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and accept. That meditation raises the counter by one but is not marked as a meditation spot, and it is gone after Chapter 1. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so the trophy is stricter than the checklist here. This is the game's only potentially missable trophy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for, as Jason, and this bronze pops. Bret's quests start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: he texts Jason and the first quest, Veteran Hunted, begins in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons, and you hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. The honest catch, and the reason this trophy sits in the Unconfirmed section, is that no guide has yet confirmed which animal actually triggers it: PowerPyx, GTABase and eGamers all say so. The safe play is to clear all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, so the trophy should pop somewhere along the way. Use the unique hunting rifle Bret gives you, the Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. You do not need all of them for this trophy, and the Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so pick the three sets you are nearest to completing and finish those first. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and will still count toward your progress, so do not hoard them out of caution. The 100% checklist raises the bar to 15 of 18 sets, which means this silver will pop long before you are done with cards, and the real card grind belongs to the checklist stage, not here. If you are early in the game, just collect cards as you find them and let the sets accumulate; the trophy arrives naturally somewhere in the middle of the card hunt.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app by holding Up on the D-pad and then R1. Any 100 count, drawn from 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags, so you are choosing from well over a hundred candidates and the trophy is generous about which ones you pick. Scan everything you pass from the start of the game and this resolves itself: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures are all over Leonida, and the same app scans vehicles too, so one habit covers two trophies. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so the trophy target and the checklist target are identical here, which is rare in this list, and finishing this trophy finishes that checklist line too.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. Challenges are tracked under Progress, then Challenges, where finished ones carry a tick, and there are 10 more than you need for the 100% checklist, which wants 70, so you can skip the hardest ones entirely. Most challenges complete themselves while you play: driving, shooting, robbing and exploring all feed them, so do not chase this trophy early. Let it accumulate through the story and the checklist, then look at what is left and pick the easiest and quickest remaining challenges. The challenges come in eight groups of ten, so if one group is fighting you, abandon it and work another: with 30 spare challenges across the whole set, there is no reason to grind the worst ones. This trophy will usually pop on the way to 70.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together; call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Getting to 4 stars is easy: cause enough chaos and the stars climb. The hard part is the escape, and the guides agree on the best route: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area, so keep driving until the zone clears. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so this often pops by itself during Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time. The wanted level must stay up, flashing red and blue, across all three robberies: if it clears, the chain breaks. Go in with body armour, sticky bombs and healing items, call your partner, and hit three robbery targets in quick succession. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well because they sit close together, and they open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, so do not panic if it is delayed; GTABase adds that if it still has not appeared, robbing a fourth shop usually finishes it. Make sure to actually loot in each store, ideally the back room safe, rather than just walking in and out.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app is enough: you do not need to drive it, and standing beside a busy road scanning passing traffic is the fastest way to rack the count up. There are 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes, so 100 is a modest slice. Check progress under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles, where scrolling over each category shows the totals found. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy is the halfway point of a longer job: keep scanning after it pops and the checklist line will follow. Start the habit in Chapter 1 and you will barely notice the grind.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus, activated with L3 and R3 while aiming. Focus slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, but it only lasts a few seconds, so preparation decides this trophy. First buff your focus by eating, drinking or washing up at home, then take Adrenaline to make it last longer, and use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 for accurate full-auto fire. Line up five enemies before you trigger it: gang members at illegal operations work well, while PowerPyx reports that soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count. Body armour helps you walk out of cover and get close. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and it gets easier as you level it, so leave this for later if it resists you early.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport, take off, and fly about 1km away from the airport. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count: it has to be a jet connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is at gates E3 and E4: drive through the airfield fence, use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. You can also enter through the airport terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster. The trophy unlock is slightly delayed and only pops once you are about a kilometre out, so keep flying away from the airport until it lands.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. The tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, at the south end of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a Rhino tank and start shooting enemies. Expect heavy resistance getting in and out of the base, so bring body armour and a fast escape vehicle for the approach, and do not be shy about using the tank's own firepower once you are inside it. There is no requirement to take the tank anywhere specific or to survive for a set time: defeating enemies from the tank is what counts, and the trophy follows quickly once you start.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and the jewelry store robberies themselves. Then break into a jewelry store through its locked back door using the Snap Gun: kicking the door in sets off the alarm, while the Snap Gun opens it silently, and the gadget stays in your inventory permanently. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. Move slowly, avoid the staff's line of sight, and leave cleanly: being spotted at any point fails the attempt, but you can try again at another store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is...: you tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase into the bank and the vault opens, and you go in while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so bring your partner and hand off a bag. After that mission, Yasmani sells tips about security vans for $10,000, marking them with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep going to 8 after this silver pops. Note the grade dispute: Push Square lists this as bronze, but the official list and every other guide say silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat zone. The easiest route is the same mission that opens the bank vaults: That's Where The Money Is... in Chapter 4 automatically counts, because robbing the bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash. You tail the truck to the bank, the guard carries the cash to the vault, you take it and escape the heat radius or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. If you want it earlier, armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks: box one in, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. Sticky bombs are available from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only unlocks once you have escaped, not when the doors blow.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane: fly over every dark patch until the entire map becomes visible. This is a pure exploration trophy with no combat or collection requirement, so it pairs well with any flying you are already doing for stunts, knife flights and under-bridge runs. Work in a grid, sweeping county by county, and check the map after each pass to find the fog you missed: the edges of the map and the islands are the usual stragglers. There is no timer and no missable element, so it can be left to the cleanup stage, but doing it early pays off because an unfogged map makes every other collectible and robbery easier to navigate.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your count under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. You only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this bronze is the first ninth of a much bigger job: do not stop at nine. Operations are also the best place to set up Gunslinger, because the gang members there count as valid targets for Combat Focus while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to. Clear them gang by gang and both trophies progress together.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This is one of the five trophies whose exact method is still unconfirmed, so this guide states plainly what is known and what is not. The description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, and GTABase's working guess is that you have a cocktail at a spot overlooking Ocean Beach in Vice City, while PowerPyx lists the trophy as currently unknown. Do not waste hours on a guessed method: go to Ocean Beach, look for a bar or cocktail spot with a view of the water, and try ordering a drink there. If nothing pops, leave it and check back as the community confirms it, because the method will be found quickly now that the game is out. The trophy is hidden, so it stays behind the spoiler shield in this codex until you reveal or earn it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This is one of the five trophies whose exact method is still unconfirmed, and the guides disagree on what it even is. PowerPyx lists Capital Offense as currently unknown, while GTABase's working guess is that the description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom. That guess is plausible, given the wording about smashing your way out in classic style, but it is a guess, and eGamers lists the steps as unconfirmed as well. If you want to try it, take a car into a vehicle showroom and drive it back out through the glass, then see if the trophy pops. If it does not, do not keep ramming showrooms: leave it for the community to confirm and spend the time on the 100% checklist instead. This codex will not present a guess as a fact.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt and Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, and escape the police. This is one of the 39 illegal gang operations, and you first go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside you need three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs, so buy those at an Ammu-Nation first. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You do not need all three in one visit: if you miss one, the robbery respawns after a long time and you can return for what is left, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters, and you check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then the character, scrolling to Strength. Work out at fitness clubs, found on the map under Activities, and always go together: call your partner along, because while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so progress doubles. You can also work out at home after the story. One dispute to note: Sixshore records that Push Square does not mark this trophy as hidden, while GTABase and the other lists count it among the 28 hidden. Our call is hidden, following the majority and the PSN data.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can see the count by clicking the trophy in your trophy list, and it is worth turning on Criminal Profile notifications in the settings under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so every profile-changing action shows a small demon face on the right of the screen. The profile has five tiers, from Professional for stealthy, clean work through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable at the far end. Most players earn this naturally while working on the robberies and the 100% checklist, because every robbery and enemy encounter counts. One warning: do not push toward Irredeemable deliberately, because it is permanent and makes the police far more aggressive. If you still need a few at the end, ordinary robberies will finish it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: This is one of the five trophies whose exact method is still unconfirmed, and the honest guide is a short one. The description, second time's the charm, suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, and PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is a belief, not a confirmed method. GTABase and eGamers both list the steps as unconfirmed. The most useful advice is what not to do: do not grind second attempts at random activities hoping one of them pops it, because the trigger is probably one specific event. Keep playing the game normally, retry things when they fail, and watch for the community to pin the trigger down. This codex lists it under Unconfirmed rather than dressing a guess up as a guide.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: This is one of the five trophies whose exact method is still unconfirmed. The description, what the hell just happened, points at a strange event or an Easter egg somewhere in Leonida, and PowerPyx believes it comes from a UFO questline, while GTABase's guess is simply that you should expect a strange event somewhere in the state. Neither is confirmed, and eGamers lists the trophy as unconfirmed as well. The practical advice is to explore widely and pay attention to odd encounters, especially at night and in remote places, since strange-event trophies in open-world games usually hide there. Do not chase it early: the method will be confirmed by the community within days of launch, and this trophy is a cleanup job, not a story job.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This is one of the five trophies whose exact method is still unconfirmed, though the description is the clearest of the five. Bowl them over with a melee drive-by means knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. GTABase agrees the description points to a melee attack from a vehicle, and eGamers lists the steps as unconfirmed. The sensible attempt is to ride a motorcycle past pedestrians and try the melee kick, or swing a melee weapon from a slow-moving car, and see whether the trophy pops. If it does not, the trigger is probably a specific enemy type or a specific vehicle, so wait for confirmation rather than running over half of Vice City.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, according to GTABase. The total is cumulative, so you do not need to bring $250,000 at once, and the robberies you do for the 100% checklist will get you there naturally, since bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery. This is also a 100% checklist line in its own right: the checklist wants $250,000 of marked bills fenced, exactly matching this trophy, so the two finish together.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. It is a running total across every kind of shop, and the fastest way to burn through it is also the most useful spending in the game: guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive items, and you will want all three anyway. PowerPyx counts the shop types as 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so there is no shortage of places to spend. Do not buy junk just to hit the number: buy the weapons, armour, vehicle upgrades and garage properties you actually need, and the total will pass $100,000 on its own during the robbery and checklist stages.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties. There are 8 garages for sale and 4 story-related garages, and only the 8 purchasable ones count. They cost about $160,000 in total, and they become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, when you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone: buy them through that app. Each garage adds parking spots, which you need for On the Spot, since registering vehicles to the Scooter Bros app needs free garage space. Robberies are the quick way to make the money, especially the higher-value jobs that open in Chapters 3 and 4, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each. Buy garages as soon as you can afford them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses, who then gives you the app and his garage in Port Gellhorn. To register a vehicle, drive a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray and then Register in his garage. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down, and make sure you have free garage space first, which is why Little Boxes pairs with this trophy: each garage adds parking spots. Ten cheap cars, ten registrations, and the trophy is done.
trophies.name: On the Spot
